headline: Declaration of Independence Read Aloud to Citizens of Philadelphia
dispatch: Philadelphia, July 8, 1776. Colonel John Nixon read the newly adopted Declaration of Independence aloud from the yard of the Pennsylvania State House today before a large gathering of citizens. The crowd received the words with considerable enthusiasm. Church bells rang across the city as the public proclamation of separation from Britain was heard for the first time by common people.
answer: Declaration of Independence read aloud publicly, 1776
